description: A Perl script for flashing firmware on devices, specifically for Fritz!Box and similar devices. It includes network device discovery via UDP broadcast, FTP communication with the device, and firmware upload procedures.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with ADAM2 devices, including environment variable retrieval, reboot, and check commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to FTP server.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Sends the PASV command to FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the device via FTP.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to device via FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device via FTP and closes connection.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a flash check command on the device via FTP.
